Responsible for collecting any necessary information for vetting purposes, as designed by IMC and/or donors. Uses required sub-award management systems for subaward issuance and management. Facilitates project kick off meetings ensuring relevant staff and partners are aware of their programmatic, financial and compliance obligations/requirements.
